scope: Fixed C1 input controls and first numerical divergence
ulp_definition: Distance in ordered IEEE BF16/FP16/FP32 encodings, signed zeros collapsed
limits: Different elements locate the first observed numerical change; they are not a cross-tiling failure gate.
Each configuration starts from the same frozen C1 parent, token, full valid prefix and ordered indices.
Four configurations observe only one fixed MTP proposal, not chain propagation or acceptance rate.
Captured MoE top-k IDs/weights are actual selector results; no synthetic router or index cutoff is substituted.
Full valid prefix before/after is independently compared from raw cache snapshots.
Original/column device weight binding uses driver CPU-copy hashes and the frozen checkpoint provenance.
No graph, target verification, teacher acceptance or TPOT claim follows.
